title: The outer sequence: order, phases, and quotient choices

conventions.composition: alpha beta = alpha composed beta; rightmost acts first
conventions.Haar: crossed-product ds; canonical dual average dt/(2*pi)

translation_system.P: B(K tensor L^2(R)) in the proved normal regular coordinates
translation_system.Phi: Tr_D with D=1_K tensor exp(Q), on the whole positive cone

finite_weight_witness.operator: A=theta_(xi,xi); not asserted to be a projection

phase_cancellation.b: b(q)=exp(iq)h, h any constant unitary in B(K)
phase_cancellation.central_implementer: z(q)=exp(-iq), so partial z=k_b and b z=h

quotient_fiber.hypothesis: A given properly infinite factor coefficient N with faithful normal semifinite tau and normal continuous theta satisfying tau theta_s=exp(-s) tau.
quotient_fiber.qualification: Conditional calculation in every such system; no claim that an arbitrary factor admits such an action.
quotient_fiber.b_1: A CST implementer with theta_s(b_1)=exp(is)b_1; no continuous family of choices asserted.
quotient_fiber.beta_1: Ad(b_1)|N lies in I but not I_0
quotient_fiber.exact_claim: The representative lift beta -> [Gamma_beta] does not descend to G/I; this does not establish nonsplitting of the extension.
